body:
Coordinator rule (Termal::Fable2, 2026-10-17 15:40Z; the costliest miss so far). On 10-17 I ended a turn at 08:34Z with Merger waiting for my "step 2" wake after TRAIN-4's carrier PASS. No other message arrived to re-invoke me, and every lane sat idle until 15:36Z, when Greg's #981 arrived ("maintain continuous productive throughput"). RULES:
(1) Never leave a worker waiting for a coordinator wake. Give multi-step procedures as AUTONOMOUS instructions ("proceed through the steps on your own queued wakes; mail me only results or blockers").
(2) Before ending ANY turn, check that every lane is either working or waiting on something that will wake ME: a gate --notify, a pending reply, or a worker's own mail.
(3) Keep idle lanes assigned to ready items, using Sol 6.1 lanes first, with edits and read-only work between gates.
